Moss's 30 September digest gives **#8841** for Mateo's Door 14 issue at Newark. The digest says Mateo Quiroga filed it on the Pemberline Dock carrier portal, where drivers on second shift can't select Door 14 on the check-in kiosk, and that you escalated it to platform engineering.

Before you pass it on, check it. The same number shows up in #strategic-pod on 1 July, where you wrote that you had closed out ticket #8841 with support. That was a kiosk browser-cache issue on a different account, so the number may have been reused or the digest may have it wrong. Confirm #8841 in the support system before the engineering follow-up.
